title: nazm.runtime/1
description: A runtime artifact's manifest (N82, `docs/internal/architecture.md` §7.83): what `libnazmrt.a` beside it is. Written by `nazm runtime build`; read by `nazm build --runtime` and `nazm runtime verify`, which refuse an artifact whose schema, ABI revision, runtime digest, target, profile or archive bytes do not fit, or that lacks a service the program reaches.

abi.description: The runtime ABI revision it was built at.

runtime.description: The runtime digest of the compiler that built it: BLAKE3 over every runtime text, the entry and the inventory, hex.

services.description: The services it provides: every one for `hosted`; `stack` for a board or WebAssembly, whose missing services the freestanding build itself refuses.

toolchain.description: The first line of the C compiler's `--version`.

text.description: BLAKE3 of the runtime text compiled, hex.

archive.description: BLAKE3 of `libnazmrt.a`, hex: what the archive's bytes must hash to.
